set.body: Establish real Unicode grapheme/word/line segmentation and bidi analysis for shared text layout using the ICU4X C API in an isolated Native probe. Pin artifacts, headers and official conformance fixtures; own/copy text buffers and outputs, bound work, test real Unicode cases and record full/trimmed artifact sizes where feasible. Probe links ICU4X alone; production co-linking with wgpu/AccessKit requires unified sirin-native first. No hand-written Unicode rules, synthetic passing fixtures or claims of full paragraph/caret/UI layout. Preserve kernel work and run JVM/Native checks.
set.title: G-0/P0.8: Qualify ICU4X Unicode analysis through pointer-only shim
